hotel_name: Radisson Blu Hotel, New Delhi Paschim Vihar

positive_snippets: Thank you for your exceptional service at the restaurant Disha, Pawan, Mukul and Gurmeet, Ramjan, Muskaan.   You made sure that we were satisfied with service, checking with us every time , served us food like we were family at breakfast and dinner. The staff gave us a discount for our dinner (we didnt include dinner, breakfast is complementary)..Your attention to details was impeccable. Thank you Chef Brijesh and Chef Hemant and the entire staff for your hardwork. The food was delicious and menu was good (lot of options 🤤). We had a smooth check in as well. Thankyou Mr Rohit. To be honest I'm glad we didn't chose any other hotel to stay for one 1 week trip from Kerala to Delhi.

We recently celebrated my husband’s birthday at Oro Bar (Radisson Blu, Paschim Vihar), and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish.
The Highlights:
• The staff, Manager, Mr. Sandeep, support staff Mr. Sandeep and Mr. Sohail went above and beyond with the table arrangements. The rose decor was elegant and added a beautiful, romantic touch to our evening that made the occasion feel truly special.
• Absolutely extremely good food. Every dish we ordered was flavorful, well-presented, and arrived at the perfect temperature. It’s rare to find a bar that treats its menu with as much care as its drinks.
•The team was attentive without being intrusive, ensuring our celebration went off without a hitch.

The complete staff is very cooperative and ambience is superb. The food quality is also awesome & service is appreciated. Especially want to share about Sunil sharma, Raj kumar Thapa & Yogendra for their support. We are doing this meeting for the second time for all the North employees because of their behaviour & service.
